name: manual_f451fd
claim: coord_pulse.ps1 and coord_monitor.ps1 do NOT source .env.local (only start.ps1 does, via scripts/env/load-local.ps1) -- any cross-machine config set only in .env.local (tokens, MAC_IP, timeouts) will not reach these scripts or the Scheduled Task that runs them. Persist such values as actual Windows User-level environment variables, not just .env.local, if coord scripts need them too.

decisions.notes: Fixed .env.local with the correct ORAMA_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN/MAC_IP/LAN_PEER_STATUS_TIMEOUT and confirmed start.ps1-launched services worked, but coord_pulse.ps1 run separately still failed with stale/default values until the same values were also set as persistent User env vars.

rationale: Fixed .env.local with the correct ORAMA_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN/MAC_IP/LAN_PEER_STATUS_TIMEOUT and confirmed start.ps1-launched services worked, but coord_pulse.ps1 run separately still failed with stale/default values until the same values were also set as persistent User env vars.
